targets.name: matmul_3x3_z
targets.title: 3x3x3 Matrix Multiplication over Z
targets.summary: Find an exact integer bilinear decomposition (u, v, w) for 3x3x3 matrix multiplication over Z with rank < holder (Laderman SOTA 23).
targets.approach: Submit a strict JSON decomposition {target, ring, m, k, n, rank, u, v, w} over Z with rank < holder.

targets.name: matmul_4x4_f2
targets.title: 4x4x4 Matrix Multiplication over GF(2)
targets.summary: Beat AlphaTensor's 47-multiplication scheme for 4x4x4 matrix multiplication over GF(2) (baseline 64, Strassen 49).
targets.approach: Submit a strict JSON decomposition over GF(2) with entries in {0, 1} and rank < holder.

targets.name: matmul_4x4_q
targets.title: 4x4x4 Matrix Multiplication over Q
targets.summary: Beat Strassen (49) and AlphaEvolve (48) on exact 4x4x4 matrix multiplication over Q using exact integers or reduced p/q rationals.
targets.approach: Submit a strict JSON decomposition over Q (integers or reduced p/q strings) with rank < holder.
